# owner: platform
"""Plain-text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable, List
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date


def _compose(student: Student, days: List[date]) -> str:
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {len(days)} day(s): {dates}."


# ---
def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    marks = list(marks)
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ValueError("marks belong to a different student")
    days = sorted(mark.day for mark in marks if mark.status == "absent")
    if not days:
        raise ValueError("no absences to report")
    return _compose(student, days)
after.tests/test_notices.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_sorted_absences(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 4), "present"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertEqual(text, "Ada Lovelace missed 2 day(s): 2026-09-02, 2026-09-05.")

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [Mark("s2", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
